Author: goodmasta
Name: TomeScroll Chat
Punchline: A fully custom, tab-based replacement for the in-game chat window.
Description: Replaces the default FFXIV chat log with a custom ImGui interface: unlimited freely-configurable tabs (any mix of channels), any tab can be popped out into its own floating window, whispers get their own per-partner tab or window, clickable links, BTTV/7TV emote rendering, and disk-backed history capped at 1 GiB. Not affiliated with Twitch, BetterTTV or 7TV.
